notes: g1-code group: F01 source-code repositories, F02 build trees, F03 dependency/vendor trees, F18 near-duplicate/versioned trees. Generated by research/corpus/generators/g1-code/authoring/make_sources.py from upstreams.py and downloads.lock.json (retrieval date 2026-09-12). Split upstreams are disjoint: tuning = zstd, ripgrep, curl, llvm-project, sqlite, lz4, TypeScript devDeps, PyPI scientific stack, fzf; validation = CPython, redis, bat, bootstrap, cJSON, yq; heldout = Linux 6.6, Go, musl, PostgreSQL, Lua, alacritty, pdf.js, PyPI web-service stack, direnv. Build and vendor recipes need setup_build_deps.sh (apt) and the pinned toolchains asserted in their params. Vendor trees from different splits unavoidably share some ubiquitous third-party packages (e.g. common crates or npm packages).
